name: EV Charging Stations
description: Electric vehicle charging station locations and connector details from official national feeds, OpenChargeMap, NOBIL, and OpenStreetMap

dataSources.purpose: EV charging station locations with connector details, power levels, availability, merged provider records, and data-provider/license attribution
dataSources.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates (south, west, north, east), optional filters (connector type, usage type, status)
dataSources.dataReceived: Charging stations with connector types, power levels, operator info, pricing, availability status, merged source ids, and per-record data-provider/license metadata when available

dataSources.purpose: Official and national EV charging station datasets for the United States, Germany, France, Switzerland, Norway, and Sweden
dataSources.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates (south, west, north, east); configured AFDC and NOBIL API keys are sent only server-side when those sources are enabled
dataSources.dataReceived: Charging station records with location, operator, connector, access, payment, opening-hours, source, and license metadata

dataSources.purpose: EV charging station locations from OpenStreetMap (secondary source, global fallback)
dataSources.dataReceived: OSM charging station nodes with name, operator, socket types, capacity, fee info
